themes.label: Cinema title sequences
themes.triviaNote: A title treatment can suggest a genre, period or mood before the story begins. Designers use type proportions, contrast and spacing as part of the visual world-building.

themes.label: Poster culture
themes.triviaTitle: Posters are read at a glance
themes.triviaNote: A poster has to establish hierarchy at a distance. A strong typeface gives the title a memorable silhouette while weight and spacing help the message survive a quick look.

themes.label: Editorial mastheads
themes.triviaNote: A publication's masthead has to remain recognizable across issues and formats. Letterform character, spacing and proportion help create a consistent editorial voice.

themes.label: Wayfinding and signage
themes.triviaNote: Wayfinding type must work at a distance and under time pressure. Open counters, clear letter differentiation and appropriate spacing can make signs easier to scan.

themes.label: Book-cover typography
themes.triviaTitle: A cover gives the first impression
themes.triviaNote: Book covers use type to signal tone and genre before a reader opens the book. Scale, contrast and the relationship between title and author name create hierarchy.

themes.label: Record sleeves and album artwork
themes.triviaTitle: Type can carry a musical identity
themes.triviaNote: Album artwork often uses typography as part of the artist's visual identity. Letterform shape, density and spacing can communicate energy, restraint or a particular era.

themes.label: Sports identity systems
themes.triviaNote: Sports identities must remain recognizable on uniforms, scoreboards and small digital surfaces. Distinctive shapes and robust spacing help type survive very different viewing conditions.

themes.label: Packaging typography
themes.triviaTitle: Hierarchy helps people scan a pack
themes.triviaNote: Packaging combines brand expression with practical information. Type size, contrast and spacing help separate the product name, key claims and supporting details.

themes.label: Fashion wordmarks
themes.triviaTitle: Small changes create a distinct voice
themes.triviaNote: Fashion wordmarks often rely on subtle differences in proportion, spacing and stroke contrast. A restrained typographic choice can become a recognizable brand signature.

themes.label: Protest and movement graphics
themes.triviaNote: Movement graphics are often designed to be read quickly in public spaces. Scale, weight and direct letterforms help a message remain clear when viewed at a distance or in motion.

themes.label: Digital interface typography
themes.triviaNote: Interface typography must remain readable across screen sizes and pixel densities. Clear forms, consistent spacing and a useful hierarchy support scanning and interaction.

themes.label: Museum and exhibition identity
themes.triviaNote: Exhibition typography appears in titles, labels, maps and directional signs. A coherent type system connects these touchpoints while allowing each information level to remain distinct.
